Chapter 1084: Chapter 19 Advancement in Strength (Please Subscribe)_3

Even if it were achievable, as long as the opponent had other means of self-preservation, they could annihilate their flesh and soul with a single thought and then revive through contingency methods.

No cultivator would ever want their physical body to fall into the hands of others for research.

…

While Lin Yuan was absorbing the numerous inheritances left behind by the Tuolong Great Saint,

he also began to sort through the treasure trove of resources within the inheritance space.

Buzz, buzz, buzz.

With a thought, the various halls within the inheritance space released one rare treasure after another, each exuding a distinct aura.

A ten-meter-wide piece of violet crystal appeared, its interior visibly flowing with purple liquid.

“The Violet Jade Nest?”

Lin Yuan felt a surge of joy. This piece of Violet Jade Nest was a treasure of the Chaos Realm tier, and even a fragment of this size held a value of no less than a million Chaos Realm stones.

To put it into perspective, the ‘Fragmented World’ made of Star Tears that Lin Yuan had purchased—spanning light-years in size—was only worth over a million Chaos Realm stones in total.

Yet the Violet Jade Nest, merely ten meters in size, commanded a similar price.

Lin Yuan’s gaze shifted toward the other treasures presented.

There were several yellow orbs, gently colliding with one another and emanating a calming aura that soothed the mind.

There was also a Nine-Colored Herb, which had grown nine distinct leaves of varying hues…

….

“All these treasures combined, if converted to Chaos Stones, would likely be worth around thirty-eight million Chaos Stones…”

Lin Yuan was quite satisfied. The inheritance space created by the Tuolong Great Saint was meant to cultivate successors. But nurturing successors required more than mere guidance; it demanded extensive resources.

Close to two million Chaos Stones worth of staggering resources was more than sufficient to support an ordinary Eleventh-Tier being through their breakthrough into the Chaos Realm without lacking anything.

“Directly consuming these resources might be wasteful. It’s better to convert them into Chaos Stones and exchange them for items more suitable for me.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

For instance, the rare Nine-Colored Herb had the effect of stabilizing the physical body and the internal cosmos. For those who had just entered the Supreme tier, whose bodies and internal cosmos were rapidly evolving, this herb was immensely beneficial.

But to consume it directly?

Its value would drop significantly, an utter waste of its potential.

Lin Yuan was still some distance away from breaking through to the Supreme tier. Moreover, given his profound foundation, he wouldn’t need external aids like this to stabilize himself upon stepping into the Chaos Realm.

Thus, trading it for resources more suited to him was the optimal choice.

…

The Ancient Ming Chaos Continent.

“Galaxy.” Wanqu Dominator smiled at Lin Yuan.

Due to the instructions of his master, the Ancient Ming Venerable, Wanqu Dominator held Lin Yuan in high regard.

No matter how busy he was, as long as Lin Yuan sought him out, he would make the time to meet him.

“Wanqu.” Lin Yuan savored the fine wine before him, “This time, I’ve come to sell some of the rare treasures I possess.”

“Sell rare treasures?” Wanqu Dominator’s face lit up with a smile. “Anything Galaxy takes out, I, Wanqu, will gladly purchase.”

Lin Yuan had sold some treasures and weapons to him in the past, and their transactions had always been pleasant.

Wanqu Dominator upheld a principle: he would rather earn less—or even nothing—if it meant satisfying Lin Yuan.

In truth, with the treasures and weapons Lin Yuan had sold previously, Wanqu Dominator had made a modest profit overall.

“Take a look first.”

Lin Yuan flipped his hand, bringing out some of the resources from the inheritance space.

The ten-meter Violet Jade Nest… the Nine-Colored Herb…

“Hmm?”

Wanqu Dominator’s expression instantly shifted.

The treasures Lin Yuan brought out were all of Chaos Realm tier, and their value within the Chaos Realm tier was anything but low.

“So many rare treasures…” Wanqu couldn’t help but feel a chill. Could it be that Lin Yuan had plundered the lair of a Chaos Venerable?

“What’s wrong? Is there an issue?”

Lin Yuan stared at Wanqu Dominator.

“No, no issue at all.” Wanqu Dominator quickly shook his head. “It’s just that these treasures are so precious, I’ll need to consult my master.”

Dealing with treasures of the Chaos Venerable level was beyond his authority and required the approval of the Ancient Ming Venerable.

“Alright, go ahead.”

Lin Yuan nodded in understanding.

“You’ll have my answer shortly.”

Wanqu Dominator immediately split off a trace of his consciousness to form an avatar and personally headed to the secluded cultivation space of the Ancient Ming Venerable.

…

“Master, Galaxy wishes to sell some rare treasures…”

Wanqu Dominator approached the Ancient Ming Venerable and quickly explained the situation.

“These?” The Ancient Ming Venerable was equally astonished. Some of the treasures Lin Yuan had brought out were items that even Chaos Venerables rarely encountered.

“Master, should we take them?”

Wanqu Dominator immediately asked.

“Take them, of course, take them.”

The Ancient Ming Venerable’s eyes widened. “So many rare treasures, many of them are seldom seen. Even if we couldn’t sell them, I would still gladly accept them myself.”

With a solemn expression, the Ancient Ming Venerable quickly assigned prices to each item.

Compared to their market value, the Ancient Ming Venerable chose the highest possible prices.

First, these treasures were indeed rare.

Second, the prophetic visions concerning Lin Yuan by the Chaos Dragon Beast were terrifying. The Ancient Ming Venerable was determined to curry favor, let alone haggle over prices.

…

After Wanqu Dominator left,

the Ancient Ming Venerable’s expression quickly regained its composure.

“Ancient Ming.”

A black-robed youth appeared beside him.

“This ‘Galaxy’, it seems, is a reincarnated Great Saint.”

The black-robed youth spoke in a low voice, having overheard the entire conversation between the Ancient Ming Venerable and Wanqu Dominator.

“Indeed.”

The Ancient Ming Venerable nodded.

Based on the black-robed youth’s foresight, offending Lin Yuan would lead to certain death.

This could only mean that Lin Yuan would almost certainly ascend to the rank of Great Saint in the future. Otherwise, how could such a fate be predicted?

But forget the Path Splitting Realm—how could even Chaos Venerables be certain of ascending to the status of a Great Saint?

Only a reincarnated Great Saint could assert with certainty that they would reclaim their former glory.

Thus, the Ancient Ming Venerable and the black-robed youth became increasingly convinced that Lin Yuan was a reincarnated Great Saint.

Now that they saw Lin Yuan present so many Chaos Realm tier rare treasures,

their theory that Lin Yuan was a reincarnated Great Saint was virtually confirmed.

These treasures—rare even by Chaos Realm standards—were almost inexplicable, unless they were preparations made before a Great Saint’s reincarnation.

Lin Yuan must have recovered some of his memories from his time at the Great Saint level and retrieved the contingencies he had prepared at his peak.

“A Great Saint…”

The Ancient Ming Venerable and the black-robed youth exchanged glances, their hearts filled with awe and amazement.
